why: Three definitions (the abstract Schema, MappingSchema, and the CustomSchema subclass defined inside a test in tests/test_schema.py) and 25 calls in 8 files (plus one test that names the method as a string, `patch.object(schema, "column_names", ...)`), on receivers named `schema`, `self.schema`, `resolver.schema` and `self`: the optimizer (qualify_columns, annotate_types, isolate_table_selects, resolver), sqlglot/lineage.py and the tests.
